Discrete wavelet parts of a column.

pywt.wavedec of one numeric column (symmetric mode): each part brought back to the rows and added beside every input column as &lt;column>_A&lt;level> and &lt;column>_D&lt;level> .. &lt;column>_D1, plus &lt;column>_denoised when the details are thresholded (soft or hard, at the universal threshold or the one typed).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Signal](../categories/signal.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `WaveletTransform` |
| Search words | wavelet, dwt, denoise, parts |

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |

| **Data** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input table containing the signal column |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Parts** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input table plus the part columns (and the denoised column) |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| signal_col | `signal_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Numeric signal column. Required. |
| wavelet | `wavelet` | Choice | `db4` | `haar`, `db1`, `db2`, `db3`, `db4`, `db5`, `db6`, `db7`, `db8`, `sym2`, `sym3`, `sym4`, `sym5`, `sym6`, `sym7`, `sym8`, `coif1`, `coif2`, `coif3`, `coif4`, `coif5` | The run | PyWavelets' filters. |
| level | `level` | Integer | `3` | `>= 1` | The run | Levels (at most pywt.dwt_max_level for the rows and the wavelet) |
| denoise | `denoise` | Choice | `off` | `off`, `soft`, `hard` | The run | Threshold the details and add &lt;column>_denoised. |
| threshold | `threshold` | Number | `0` | `>= 0` | The run | 0: the universal threshold sigma sqrt(2 ln n), sigma from the finest details. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).
